scripts.build: npm run build -w @email-fetch/shared && npm run build -w @email-fetch/api && npm run build -w @email-fetch/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,worker,web -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @email-fetch/shared" "npm run dev -w @email-fetch/api" "npm run worker:dev -w @email-fetch/api" "npm run dev -w @email-fetch/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @email-fetch/shared && npm run test -w @email-fetch/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @email-fetch/shared && npm run typecheck -w @email-fetch/api && npm run typecheck -w @email-fetch/web
